about.title: About Savings Calculator
about.description: The Savings Calculator helps you estimate how regular deposits, interest, and time may affect progress toward a savings goal. It can be used to review different deposit amounts, frequencies, and rates so you can compare scenarios and see how they change your projected balance over time. Use it as a planning reference when reviewing savings goals.

faq.q: How much should I save each month?
faq.a: A common rule is to save 20% of your income, but this varies by individual circumstances. Start with what you can afford and gradually increase as your income grows. The key is consistency and building the habit.

faq.q: What's a good interest rate for savings?
faq.a: Savings account rates vary widely based on market conditions, institution type, and account terms. Compare APY, fees, access restrictions, and deposit insurance coverage when reviewing account options.

faq.q: Should I save daily, weekly, or monthly?
faq.a: More frequent deposits can slightly increase compound interest earnings, but the convenience of monthly deposits often outweighs the small difference in returns. Choose a frequency that matches your income schedule.

faq.q: How long will it take to reach my savings goal?
faq.a: This depends on your goal amount, current savings, deposit frequency, and interest rate. The calculator estimates a timeline based on your inputs so you can review how changes in deposits or rates may affect the projection.
